title: Project Mania PvP
description: Project Mania is a character based arena pvp server. There are different characters with unique kits and different gamemodes and maps.
body: Project Mania is a character based arena pvp server. There are 9 different characters with unique kits and abilities. There are also 2 different gamemodes and 4 maps that more will added soon. Give it a try ;)
